flag.title: Employee handbook on assignment email
flag.description: Attaches the employee handbook PDF (read from this portal's storage) to the email a jobseeker receives when they are assigned to a position.
flag.notes: Previously hard-coded for Godspeed. Where the handbook is read from and what the attachment is called are settings below; the defaults are Godspeed's.
